## Authors / Editors

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Zuǒshì zhuàn shuō* 左氏傳說 in twenty juan is one of three principal *Zuǒzhuàn* works of Lǚ Zǔqiān [呂祖謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%82%E7%A5%96%E8%AC%99) (1137–1181), known as *Dōnglái xiānshēng* 東萊先生. The other two are [KR1e0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0040) *Zuǒshì zhuàn xù shuō* and [KR1e0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0041) *Zuǒshì bó yì*; together with the lost *Zuǒzhuàn lèi biān* 左傳類編 (in 19 categories) they constitute Lǚ's lifelong *Zuǒzhuàn* programme. The present work is rich and detailed expository discussion organised by *zhuàn*-passage, with extensive analytical comment. Originally 30 juan (per Chén Zhènsūn's *Shū lù jiětí*); the present text is 20 juan, with the additional 10 juan being the separate *Xù shuō* recovered from the *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn*. The Sìkù base is the WYG copy.

**Abstract**

The *Sìkù tíyào* makes the principal points: that this is one of Lǚ Zǔqiān's three principal *Zuǒzhuàn* works, the rich and detailed expository version; that the work is closely related to the *Bó yì* [KR1e0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0041) but with fuller exposition; that Chén Zhènsūn's "30 juan" total combines the present 20 juan plus the 10-juan *Xù shuō* [KR1e0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0040), the latter recovered separately from the *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn*; that Zhū Xī's verdict — "clever" prose targeting Hàn-period villainy — captures Lǚ's polemical edge but does not impugn his judgement.

The work belongs to the Lǚ-school *Chūnqiū* and *Zuǒzhuàn* line that had begun with Lǚ Hàowèn, continued via Lǚ Běnzhōng [KR1e0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0035) and Lǚ Zǔqiān's senior teacher Lín Zhīqí 林之奇 (1112–1176), and culminated in Lǚ Zǔqiān himself. The school's signature is exhaustive coverage with precise source-attribution.
